technical.summary: Mixed technicals with short-term bullish momentum (RSI, Supertrend, SAR) conflicting with weak trend structure (ADX 14.76), price below key moving averages, and bearish MACD crossover; neutral sector backdrop offers no tailwind.

fundamental.summary: DHI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 42 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (370), flat yield curve, imminent CPI event (1 day), and negative macro score (-5) create severely unfavourable conditions for Consumer Discretionary trading; earnings in 42 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (RSI bullish, Supertrend bullish, SAR bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (11/100) creates contrarian buy setup near support (69.127), offering asymmetric risk/reward if panic reverses.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 370, CPI event in 1 day, flat yield curve, high credit spreads), price is below all key moving averages (EMA-9/20/50, SMA-200), MACD just bearish-crossed, ADX is weak (14.76), fundamentals are absent (no insider/institutional conviction, high earnings risk in 42 days), and no active strategies triggered—creating a perfect storm of structural weakness masking short-term noise.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum (RSI, Supertrend, SAR bullish) and extreme fear sentiment (11/100) create a contrarian setup at support. However, macro crisis conditions (VIX 370, CPI event in 1 day) and structural weakness (price below all key MAs, MACD bearish cross, weak ADX) overwhelm the opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent CPI event (1 day) in crisis VIX regime (370) could trigger sharp reversal; Consumer Discretionary is highly sensitive to macro shocks and rate expectations.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on macro headwinds and structural weakness outweighing short-term momentum
decision.portfolio_note: Already 10 positions in Consumer Discretionary sector; adding DHI increases concentration risk during unfavourable macro environment without fundamental conviction.
